title: planTrackerIgnoreExpiry
responsibility: Plan the unignore write for an ignored Tracker item whose ignored_until has passed, treating a date as ending at 00:00 in the Tracker zone.

inputs.name: planTrackerIgnoreExpiry.item
inputs.description: Stored item with its status, ignore end, previous status and pending flag.

inputs.name: planTrackerIgnoreExpiry.clock
inputs.description: Current time, writing node and optional Tracker time zone, Europe/Lisbon by default.

outputs.name: planTrackerIgnoreExpiry
outputs.description: Fields restoring the previous status with an expiry note, or undefined while the item stays ignored or is not ignored.
